layers.text: Style: clean flat pixel art game texture: flat colours, low detail, small simple shapes, no outlines.

layers.text: Camera: straight top-down view of flat ground filling the whole canvas edge to edge, no perspective, no horizon, no lighting gradient.

Class: one seamless repeating ground texture swatch, the same everywhere from edge to edge, with no focal object and nothing tall: only flat ground with small low details scattered evenly over it. The texture continues past all four edges of the image.
